Definition: from G1909 and G5548; to smear over:--anoint.
BiblicalUsage: Epichrio means to smear over, to anoint — and Jesus anoints the blind man's eyes with clay made of spittle, then sends him to wash in Siloam. The man says, He put clay upon mine eyes, and I washed, and do see.
TheologicalSignificance: Jesus heals in His own way, I hold: strange means, simple obedience, and sight that no one can explain away.
RelatedEvents: The Healing of the Man Born Blind
